Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 PM EDT Sat Oct 3 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Southwestern Gulf of America:
A broad area of low pressure could form in a few days over the
southwestern Gulf of America. Any development of this system
is expected to be slow to occur as it drifts over the southwestern
Gulf waters.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

$$
Forecaster Blake
